name: prose-lint
description: Runs the wording linters on a Japanese or English document and rules on every hit: textlint with Japanese and English configs (the kana rules of 内閣訓令 through prh and the hiragana rules, い抜き・さ入れ・フィラー, the AI-writing and AI-words presets), a register of rejected wordings that you grow row by row (definition by negation, the spoken register, the stock phrases of generated Japanese), natural-japanese's lint with its naturalness score and baseline rerun, a sudachipy morphology lint (four checks from 公用文作成の考え方 and five house rules), an academic mode for Japanese papers, theses and reports (47 register rows of spoken or over-stiff wordings, each citing the university writing guides, lab guides and corpus studies it rests on, and two morphology checks), and vale with proselint, the ai-tells package and three house rules: two for the signs of LLM-written English and a comma cap for sentences strung on commas. The Japanese side also settles a style before any layer runs (what the document is, its reader, its 文体, and where its words come from), sends the document to a reader in a fresh context that finds translationese from a sourced reference, and runs a register of 13 translationese forms, each resting on a style guide or study and measured against 83 human-written documents. Blog posts, essays and slide decks (a .pptx included) also run stop-ai-slop-jp by Daichi Nagashima: its phrase lists and symbol rules as a register of 31 rows measured on technical books and Wikipedia articles, its structure patterns read by the fresh-context reader, and its five-axis score. Each sentence is also judged against exemplar passages of present-day Japanese for the document's style, quoted from 公用文, a council report, a government technical guide and award-winning papers. Its hooks lint each document Claude writes and each Japanese reply with textlint and the register, run the register on the Japanese in source files, and hold back a plan that leaves points open; installing asks whether to turn them on. prose-lint is an independent project; proselint is a separate linter by other authors.

lint_hooks.title: Wording-check hooks
lint_hooks.description: Lint each document Claude writes, the Japanese in source files and each Japanese reply with textlint and your register, check each plan and question before it reaches you, and hand the findings to Claude. Change it later with /plugin configure prose-lint@prose-lint.
